review_reason: Phase 9 (modalExpandBranchesD_hintikka) is BLOCKED: the generic top-loop Hintikka engine in CompletenessLoop.lean (modalExpandBranchesGen_hintikka -> modalExpandBranchesHintikka) is typed over RuleApplicationSpec/RuleApplicationSpecCore (universal in phi0); D can only supply RuleApplicationSpecCoreAt (a non-coercible different type). A decision is needed between (1) widening file_scope further and spawning a successor task for the twin chain, or (2) generalizing the seven declarations in place to take raw hypotheses instead of a bundled spec type. Full detail in plans/01_serial-d-driver-route-e2.md phase 9 BLOCKER block and summaries/01_serial-d-driver-route-e2-summary.md.
